body:
I'm upgrading Temporal from version 1.29 to 1.30.4.

## Expected Behavior

Database migration succeeds.

## Actual Behavior

Database migration fails.

```
2026-04-13T12:25:24.828Z	DEBUG	running 4 updates for current version 1.9	{"logging-call-at": "/home/runner/work/temporal/temporal/tools/common/schema/updatetask.go:114"}
2026-04-13T12:25:24.828Z	DEBUG	---- Executing updates for version 1.10 ----	{"logging-call-at": "/home/runner/work/temporal/temporal/tools/common/schema/updatetask.go:133"}
2026-04-13T12:25:24.828Z	DEBUG	ALTER TABLE executions_visibility ADD COLUMN TemporalReportedProblems JSONB GENERATED ALWAYS AS (search_attributes->'TemporalReportedProblems') STORED;	{"logging-call-at": "/home/runner/work/temporal/temporal/tools/common/schema/updatetask.go:135"}
2026-04-13T12:25:24.959Z	DEBUG	CREATE INDEX by_temporal_reported_problems ON executions_visibility USING GIN (namespace_id, TemporalReportedProblems jsonb_path_ops);	{"logging-call-at": "/home/runner/work/temporal/temporal/tools/common/schema/updatetask.go:135"}
2026-04-13T12:25:24.961Z	ERROR	Unable to update SQL schema.	{"error": "error executing statement: pq: data type character has no default operator class for access method \"gin\"", "logging-call-at": "/home/runner/work/temporal/temporal/tools/sql/handler.go:53"}
```  

## Steps to Reproduce the Problem

Using the `temporalio/admin-tools:1.30.4` Docker image, I'm executing this command to upgrade the visibility store of a working 1.29 instance:

```bash
temporal-sql-tool --plugin postgres12 --ep $POSTGRESQL_SEEDS -u $POSTGRESQL_USER -p 5432 --db $DB_NAME --ca "search_path=$DB_VISIBILITY_SCHEMA" --tls --tls-cert-file $POSTGRESQL_TLS_CERT_FILE --tls-key-file $POSTGRESQL_TLS_KEY_FILE --tls-ca-file $POSTGRESQL_TLS_CA_FILE update-schema -d /etc/temporal/schema/postgresql/v12/visibility/versioned
``` 

## Specifications

  - Version: 1.29 -> 1.30.4
  - Platform: Linux + Docker

comments.body:
We are seeing this migration not fail, but take an inordinately long time (requiring downtime?) as it rewrites every row in the table due to this:

```sql
ALTER TABLE executions_visibility ADD COLUMN TemporalReportedProblems JSONB GENERATED ALWAYS AS (search_attributes->'TemporalReportedProblems') STORED;
```

We have an `executions_visibility` table with over 30 million rows and hundreds of gigabytes of indexes.

The index creation afterwards is also not concurrent, which scares me a little - but we haven't even made it that far yet.
for second issue reported by @smcgivern this we need to look into this more, i cannot find way atm that would allow to bypass sequential update

title: PSQL visibility database migration fails going from 1.29 to 1.30
